beats.text: Chair and members of the Audit and Risk Committee,
beats.headline: Audit & Risk Committee

beats.text: Sixty60 faces a three-hundred-percent order surge,
beats.headline: 300% order surge
beats.sub: Demand far beyond normal store capacity

beats.text: Stage Six load-shedding
beats.headline: Stage 6 load-shedding

beats.text: and thirty-minute stock delays.
beats.headline: 30-minute stock delays
beats.sub: The app shows stock the store no longer has

beats.text: Customers order unavailable goods,
beats.headline: Customers order unavailable goods
beats.sub: Orders fail at the picking stage

beats.text: while drivers save addresses and gate codes on personal phones.
beats.headline: Gate codes on personal phones

beats.text: Managers' shortcuts keep orders moving,
beats.headline: Shortcuts keep orders moving

beats.text: but the Board must direct resilience investment, privacy safeguards and accountability.
beats.headline: The Board must direct

beats.text: Inaction means cancelled orders, lost trust and serious POPIA Section Nineteen exposure.
beats.headline: Inaction = POPIA s19 exposure
beats.sub: Cancelled orders · Lost trust · Legal risk

beats.text: Protecting the sixty-minute promise requires resilient stores and secure delivery.
beats.headline: Protect the 60-minute promise

beats.text: SAM exposes four connected gaps.
beats.headline: Strategic Alignment Model

beats.text: Business strategy promises fast delivery.
beats.headline: Business strategy

beats.text: IT strategy relies on cloud routing.
beats.headline: IT strategy

beats.text: Business infrastructure and processes still depend on manual power transfers and informal onboarding.
beats.headline: Business infrastructure & processes

beats.text: IT infrastructure and processes produce stale stock and unmanaged endpoints.
beats.headline: IT infrastructure & processes

beats.text: Strategic drift occurs because growth has outpaced store resilience:
beats.headline: Strategic drift

beats.text: available cloud services cannot correct delayed store data.
beats.headline: The cloud can't fix late data
beats.sub: Delayed store data stays wrong upstream

beats.text: Pingo's provisional maturity rating is Level One, Initial:
beats.headline: Maturity: Level 1 — Initial

beats.text: recruitment and security depend on individuals rather than repeatable, controlled procedures.
beats.headline: People, not procedures
beats.sub: Recruitment and security depend on individuals

beats.text: This is a benchmark, not a formal appraisal. The brief mixes capability and maturity terminology, so the scale needs course confirmation.
beats.headline: A benchmark, not an appraisal

beats.text: Unvetted drivers and uncontrolled customer data create serious Section Nineteen safeguard risks.
beats.headline: Section 19 safeguard risks

beats.text: Require controlled access, vetted onboarding and clear accountability.
beats.headline: Require the controls

beats.text: Maximum downtime is thirty minutes for stock-valid fulfilment and fifteen for secure delivery-detail access, protecting the sixty-minute promise.
beats.headline: Maximum tolerable downtime

beats.text: Restore sync fifteen minutes from the crash and secure dispatch within ten: both leave recovery headroom.
beats.headline: Recovery time objectives
beats.sub: Sync in 15 · dispatch in 10 · headroom left

beats.text: Five-minute RPO caps acceptable log loss without an unproven zero-loss promise;
beats.headline: RPO: 5 minutes
beats.sub: Capped log loss, no unproven zero-loss promise

beats.text: offline site loss still needs independent-copy proof.
beats.headline: Prove the independent copy
beats.sub: Offline site loss still needs evidence

beats.text: Choose independent warm standby: moderate capital and running costs, below hot replication; cold is too slow.
beats.headline: Choose warm standby
beats.sub: Moderate cost · below hot · cold is too slow

beats.text: Backup power and links must prove fifteen-minute sync.
beats.headline: Prove 15-minute sync
beats.sub: Backup power and links under test

beats.text: Losing both links breaches that target.
beats.headline: Both links down = breach

beats.text: English, isiZulu and Afrikaans instructions support safe, consistent action; fluent review remains required.
beats.headline: Instructions in three languages

beats.text: Approve a thirty-day pilot and review by day sixty.
beats.headline: Approve a 30-day pilot

beats.text: Monitor stock age above two minutes, sync beyond fifteen, dispatch beyond ten, data loss above five, and any unmanaged access.
beats.headline: Monitor five triggers
beats.sub: Breach any one and we act

beats.text: Require successful retests and cost approval before rollout.
beats.headline: Gates before rollout

beats.text: These controls protect market share, customer trust and retail resilience.
beats.headline: What these controls protect
beats.sub: Market share · Customer trust · Retail resilience

beats.text: I request formal sign-off for the pilot, executive accountability and evidence-based rollout.
beats.headline: Request: formal sign-off
